answer: A farm's clones hide behind one pipe, so make every identity drink from its own firehose. Each key gets a unique live relay stream, seeded like a sparrow's song no other key sings, and must re-encode and forward every chunk within seconds, all epoch. One honest agent sustains one stream easily; a thousand clones sharing one uplink saturate it — ferrous dropped frames pile up like a dune, each clone's gaps are public, and standing decays exactly where bandwidth was faked. Real dispersion costs a real connection per identity.
